Simulation study 1: data from known SHASH distributions with outliers added, transformed by non-robust SHASH (MLE) and robust SHASH (SHASH-i).

- Figure 4: transformed densities, n = 500, by contamination
- Figure 5: Cramér–von Mises W² against N(0, 1), n = 500, including RewML Box-Cox/YJ
- Figure S.2: QQ plots, n = 500, by contamination
- Figure S.3: transformed densities at 10% contamination, by sample size

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(arrow)
library(ggplot2)
library(gamlss)
library(gamlss.dist)
library(goftest)
library(cellWise)
library(rrobot)

plot_dir <- "plots"
data_dir <- "data"

out_dir <- file.path(plot_dir, "thr3", "Parameter Recovery")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Scenarios and settings

SHASH parameters with sigma and tau on the log scale, as rrobot takes them.
Left-skewed is part of the seed numbering but is not analysed.

```{r}
paper_params <- tibble::tribble(
  ~scenario,       ~mu, ~sigma,  ~nu,  ~tau,
  "Heavy-tailed",    0,  log(1),    0,  log(0.5),
  "Light-tailed",    0,  log(1),    0,  log(2),
  "Normal",          0,  log(1),    0,  log(1),
  "Left-skewed",     0,  log(1),   -2,  log(1),
  "Right-skewed",    0,  log(1),    2,  log(1)
)

tail_type_scenario <- function(scenario) {
  if (scenario == "Right-skewed") "upper" else if (scenario == "Left-skewed") "lower" else "both"
}

# full design; each dataset's seed is set from its position in these grids
all_sizes <- c(100, 250, 500, 1000, 2500, 5000, 10000)
all_percs <- c(0, 0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.30)
```

`run_sim = FALSE` reads the provided results (`shash_params_recovery_full_log.parquet`), which are the ones used in the paper.
`run_sim = TRUE` reruns the simulation and overwrites them. Every dataset has its own seed, so a smaller run gives exactly the matching rows of the full run.
The provided results also contain SHASH-i started at the true values (V2) and with thr1 = 2.58 (V3), which the figures don't use.

```{r}
run_sim <- FALSE

nsim         <- 100
scenarios    <- c("Normal", "Heavy-tailed", "Light-tailed", "Right-skewed")
sample_sizes <- all_sizes
perc_out     <- all_percs
versions     <- c("V1: default")   # add "V2: true start", "V3: thr1=2.58" to repeat those

results_file <- file.path(data_dir, "shash_params_recovery_full_log.parquet")
```

## Simulation

```{r}
# Cramér–von Mises W² against N(0, 1)
cvm_stat <- function(z) {
  z <- z[!is.na(z)]
  if (length(z) < 5) return(NA_real_)
  unname(goftest::cvm.test(z, null = "pnorm", mean = 0, sd = 1)$statistic)
}

# data for one simulated dataset; also used to rebuild datasets for RewML below
make_data <- function(scenario, n, percentage, sim_seed) {
  pp <- paper_params %>% filter(scenario == !!scenario)
  tl <- tail_type_scenario(scenario)
  set.seed(sim_seed)
  x <- rrobot::normal_to_SHASH(rnorm(n), mu = pp$mu, sigma = pp$sigma, nu = pp$nu, tau = pp$tau)
  k <- round(n * percentage)
  idx <- integer(0)
  if (k > 0) {
    idx <- sample(seq_len(n), k)
    ov  <- rchisq(k, df = 4) / 5 + 3
    if (tl == "both")  ov <- sample(c(-1, 1), k, replace = TRUE) * ov
    if (tl == "lower") ov <- -ov
    x[idx] <- rrobot::normal_to_SHASH(ov, mu = pp$mu, sigma = pp$sigma, nu = pp$nu, tau = pp$tau)
  }
  list(x = x, idx = idx, inl = setdiff(seq_len(n), idx))
}

sim_seed_of <- function(scenario, n, percentage, sim) {
  777L + 1000000L * match(scenario, paper_params$scenario) +
    10000L * match(n, all_sizes) + 100L * match(percentage, all_percs) + sim
}
```

The non-robust fit never calls `SHASH_out`, so rrobot's degeneracy rule (more than 1% of values beyond |z| = 20, or non-finite values) is applied to it here.

```{r, eval = run_sim}
degen_screen <- function(z, max_abs_z = 20, min_frac = 0.01) {
  if (is.null(z) || !length(z)) return(list(degenerate = NA, max_abs_z = NA_real_, n_extreme = NA_integer_))
  finite <- is.finite(z)
  mx <- if (any(finite)) max(abs(z[finite])) else Inf
  if (!all(finite)) return(list(degenerate = TRUE, max_abs_z = mx, n_extreme = 0L))
  n_ext <- sum(abs(z) > max_abs_z)
  list(degenerate = n_ext > max(1L, ceiling(min_frac * length(z))), max_abs_z = mx, n_extreme = n_ext)
}

capture_msgs <- function(expr_fun) {
  msgs <- character(0)
  degen_msg <- NA_character_
  out <- withCallingHandlers(
    expr_fun(),
    SHASH_degenerate_fit = function(w) {
      degen_msg <<- conditionMessage(w)
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    },
    warning = function(w) {
      msgs[[length(msgs) + 1]] <<- conditionMessage(w)
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )
  all_msgs <- c(out$error, msgs)
  all_msgs <- all_msgs[!is.na(all_msgs)]
  c(out, list(degen_msg = degen_msg,
              singular  = any(grepl("singular", all_msgs, ignore.case = TRUE)),
              warned    = length(all_msgs) > 0,
              msgs      = if (length(all_msgs)) paste(all_msgs, collapse = " | ") else NA_character_))
}

fit_nonrobust <- function(x) {
  r <- capture_msgs(function() tryCatch({
    e <- gamlss::coefAll(gamlss::gamlssML(x ~ 1, family = "SHASHo2", maxit = 1e4))
    list(est = e, z = rrobot::SHASH_to_normal(x, mu = e$mu, sigma = e$sigma, nu = e$nu, tau = e$tau),
         error = NA_character_)
  }, error = function(e) list(est = NULL, z = NULL, error = e$message)))
  c(r, degen_screen(r$z), list(out_idx = NULL, converged = NA, last_iter = NA_integer_))
}

# start.from is on the natural scale (gamlssML starting values)
fit_robust <- function(x, tail, thr1 = 3, start.from = NULL) {
  capture_msgs(function() tryCatch({
    res <- rrobot::SHASH_out(x, thr0 = 2.58, thr1 = thr1, thr = 3, tail = tail,
                             method_init = "isoplus", thr_iso = 0.6, start.from = start.from,
                             maxit = 100, max_abs_z = 20, min_frac = 0.01)
    list(est = res$SHASH_coef, out_idx = res$out_idx, z = res$x_norm,
         degenerate = res$degenerate, max_abs_z = res$max_abs_z, n_extreme = res$n_extreme,
         converged = isTRUE(res$converged), last_iter = res$last_iter, error = NA_character_)
  }, error = function(e) list(est = NULL, out_idx = NULL, z = NULL, degenerate = NA,
                              max_abs_z = NA_real_, n_extreme = NA_integer_,
                              converged = NA, last_iter = NA_integer_, error = e$message)))
}

fit_row <- function(f, method, version, d, sim, sim_seed, scenario, n, p, params) {
  k <- length(d$idx)
  if (!is.null(f$out_idx)) {
    tp <- length(intersect(f$out_idx, d$idx)); fp <- length(setdiff(f$out_idx, d$idx))
    tpr <- if (k > 0) tp / k else NA_real_;    fpr <- fp / (n - k)
  } else {
    tp <- NA_integer_; fp <- NA_integer_; tpr <- NA_real_; fpr <- NA_real_
  }
  getp <- function(p) if (!is.null(f$est)) f$est[[p]] else NA_real_
  tibble(
    simulation = sim, sim_seed = sim_seed, scenario = scenario, n = n, percentage = p,
    method = method, version = version,
    true_mu = params$mu, true_sigma = params$sigma, true_nu = params$nu, true_tau = params$tau,
    est_mu = getp("mu"), est_sigma = getp("sigma"), est_nu = getp("nu"), est_tau = getp("tau"),
    singular_error = f$singular, warned = f$warned, error_msg = f$msgs,
    degenerate = f$degenerate, max_abs_z = f$max_abs_z, n_extreme = f$n_extreme,
    degen_msg = f$degen_msg, iter_converged = f$converged, last_iter = f$last_iter,
    n_true_out = k, n_inlier = length(d$inl),
    TP = tp, FP = fp, TPR = tpr, FPR = fpr,
    w2_inlier = if (!is.null(f$z)) cvm_stat(f$z[d$inl]) else NA_real_,
    w2_all    = if (!is.null(f$z)) cvm_stat(f$z) else NA_real_
  )
}

version_spec <- list("V1: default"    = list(thr1 = 3,    true_start = FALSE),
                     "V2: true start" = list(thr1 = 3,    true_start = TRUE),
                     "V3: thr1=2.58"  = list(thr1 = 2.58, true_start = FALSE))

design <- expand_grid(scenario = scenarios, n = sample_sizes, percentage = perc_out, sim = seq_len(nsim))

results <- pmap_dfr(design, function(scenario, n, percentage, sim) {
  params   <- paper_params %>% filter(scenario == !!scenario)
  tail     <- tail_type_scenario(scenario)
  sim_seed <- sim_seed_of(scenario, n, percentage, sim)
  d        <- make_data(scenario, n, percentage, sim_seed)
  true_start <- c(mu = params$mu, sigma = exp(params$sigma), nu = params$nu, tau = exp(params$tau))

  rows <- list(fit_row(fit_nonrobust(d$x), "Non-robust MLE", "Non-robust",
                       d, sim, sim_seed, scenario, n, percentage, params))
  for (v in versions) {
    s <- version_spec[[v]]
    f <- fit_robust(d$x, tail, thr1 = s$thr1, start.from = if (s$true_start) true_start else NULL)
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- fit_row(f, "Robust (SHASH-i)", v, d, sim, sim_seed,
                                        scenario, n, percentage, params)
  }
  bind_rows(rows)
})

write_parquet(results, results_file)   # sigma and tau on the log scale
```

## Results

```{r}
results <- read_parquet(results_file)

# sigma and tau are stored on the log scale (true sigma = 1 is stored as 0)
stopifnot(all(abs(results$true_sigma) < 1e-8))
results <- results %>%
  mutate(true_sigma = exp(true_sigma), true_tau = exp(true_tau),
         est_sigma  = exp(est_sigma),  est_tau  = exp(est_tau))

scen_keep <- c("Normal", "Heavy-tailed", "Light-tailed", "Right-skewed")
perc_fig  <- c(0, 0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20)

# failed fits have no estimates; degenerate fits are excluded from every figure
results_kept <- results %>%
  filter(!is.na(est_mu), scenario %in% scen_keep, !(degenerate %in% TRUE))

n_sims <- n_distinct(results$simulation)
cat("rows:", nrow(results), " simulations per cell:", n_sims, "\n")
```

Degenerate fits at n = 500 (Figure 5 caption: at 20% contamination, 1 of 100 SHASH-i fits for Normal and 11 of 100 for Right-skewed).

```{r}
results %>%
  filter(version %in% c("Non-robust", "V1: default"), n == 500,
         scenario %in% scen_keep, percentage %in% perc_fig) %>%
  group_by(version, scenario, percentage) %>%
  summarise(n_fits = n(), n_degen = sum(degenerate %in% TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = percentage, values_from = n_degen) %>%
  print(width = Inf)
```

## Densities and QQ curves

Each curve shows, for one simulated dataset, the density of the inliers after transformation with that dataset's estimated parameters, computed exactly from the true SHASH distribution. A perfect fit gives N(0, 1) (dashed).

```{r}
z_grid <- seq(-6, 6, length.out = 401)

ver_lab  <- c("Non-robust" = "Non-robust MLE", "V1: default" = "SHASH-i")
meth_col <- c("SHASH-i" = "#332288", "Non-robust MLE" = "#E69F00")

fig_fits <- function(...) {
  results_kept %>%
    filter(version %in% names(ver_lab), ...) %>%
    filter(if_all(c(est_mu, est_sigma, est_nu, est_tau), is.finite)) %>%
    mutate(method_label = unname(ver_lab[version]))
}

# density of the transformed data on the z-grid (natural-scale parameters)
transformed_density <- function(fits, z) {
  nr <- nrow(fits); nz <- length(z)
  Z   <- matrix(z, nr, nz, byrow = TRUE)
  A   <- (asinh(Z) + fits$est_nu) / fits$est_tau
  X   <- fits$est_sigma * fits$est_tau * sinh(A) + fits$est_mu
  JAC <- fits$est_sigma * cosh(A) / sqrt(1 + Z^2)
  Dv  <- gamlss.dist::dSHASHo2(as.vector(X),
           mu    = rep(fits$true_mu,    times = nz),
           sigma = rep(fits$true_sigma, times = nz),
           nu    = rep(fits$true_nu,    times = nz),
           tau   = rep(fits$true_tau,   times = nz))
  D <- matrix(Dv, nr, nz) * JAC
  D[!is.finite(D)] <- NA_real_
  tibble(curve_id = rep(seq_len(nr), times = nz),
         z        = rep(z, each = nr),
         dens     = as.vector(D),
         fits[rep(seq_len(nr), times = nz), c("scenario", "n", "percentage", "method_label")])
}

# the transformation is monotone, so the p-th quantile of the transformed data is
# the estimated transformation applied to the true SHASH quantile p
qq_curves <- function(fits, p) {
  nr <- nrow(fits); np <- length(p)
  Xq <- matrix(gamlss.dist::qSHASHo2(rep(p, each = nr),
                 mu    = rep(fits$true_mu,    times = np),
                 sigma = rep(fits$true_sigma, times = np),
                 nu    = rep(fits$true_nu,    times = np),
                 tau   = rep(fits$true_tau,   times = np)), nr, np)
  Zq <- sinh(fits$est_tau * asinh((Xq - fits$est_mu) / (fits$est_sigma * fits$est_tau)) - fits$est_nu)
  Zq[!is.finite(Zq)] <- NA_real_
  tibble(curve_id = rep(seq_len(nr), times = np),
         q_theory = rep(qnorm(p), each = nr),
         q_trans  = as.vector(Zq),
         fits[rep(seq_len(nr), times = np), c("scenario", "n", "percentage", "method_label")])
}

curve_plot <- function(df, x, y, ref_layer, xlim, ylim, xlab, ylab, row_var, row_levels, row_labels) {
  lev_used <- names(meth_col)[names(meth_col) %in% unique(df$method_label)]
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(scenario     = factor(scenario, levels = scen_keep),
           row          = factor(.data[[row_var]], levels = row_levels, labels = row_labels),
           method_label = factor(method_label, levels = lev_used))

  ggplot() +
    geom_line(data = df, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]], group = interaction(method_label, curve_id),
                             colour = method_label),
              linewidth = 0.25, alpha = 0.30, na.rm = TRUE) +
    ref_layer +
    facet_grid(row ~ scenario) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = meth_col[lev_used], drop = FALSE) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 1))) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, colour = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

plot_density <- function(fits, row_var, row_levels, row_labels) {
  norm_ref <- expand_grid(z = z_grid,
                          row = factor(row_labels, levels = row_labels),
                          scenario = factor(scen_keep, levels = scen_keep)) %>%
    mutate(dens = dnorm(z))
  curve_plot(transformed_density(fits, z_grid), "z", "dens",
             geom_line(data = norm_ref, aes(z, dens), colour = "grey20", linewidth = 1.1, linetype = "22"),
             c(-5, 5), c(0, 0.65), "Transformed value", "Density", row_var, row_levels, row_labels)
}

plot_qq <- function(fits, row_var, row_levels, row_labels) {
  curve_plot(qq_curves(fits, pnorm(seq(-3, 3, length.out = 121))), "q_theory", "q_trans",
             geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey20", linewidth = 1.1, linetype = "22"),
             c(-3, 3), c(-4, 4), "N(0,1) quantile", "Quantile of transformed data",
             row_var, row_levels, row_labels)
}
```

## Figure 5: Cramér–von Mises W², n = 500

W² against N(0, 1) on the true inliers. Medians and IQRs over the simulations; degenerate fits removed.
The dashed line is 0.461, the 5% critical value of W² for a fully specified null.

RewML Box-Cox/YJ is fitted here to the same datasets, rebuilt from their seeds, with the same settings as in `02_RealDataAnalysis.Rmd`. RewML has no degeneracy rule, so none of its fits is removed. Its results are cached in `rewml_w2_n500.parquet`.

```{r}
n_cvm  <- 500
w2_ref <- 0.461

rew_file <- file.path(data_dir, paste0("rewml_w2_n", n_cvm, ".parquet"))

if (file.exists(rew_file)) {
  rew_w2 <- read_parquet(rew_file)
} else {
  ds <- results %>%
    filter(scenario %in% scen_keep, n == n_cvm, percentage %in% perc_fig) %>%
    distinct(scenario, n, percentage, simulation, sim_seed)

  rew_w2 <- pmap_dfr(ds, function(scenario, n, percentage, simulation, sim_seed) {
    d <- make_data(scenario, n, percentage, sim_seed)
    y <- tryCatch(
      suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(
        as.numeric(cellWise::transfo(d$x, type = "bestObj", robust = TRUE, standardize = TRUE)$Y))),
      error = function(e) NULL)
    tibble(scenario, n, percentage, simulation, sim_seed,
           rew_failed = is.null(y),
           w2_inlier  = if (is.null(y)) NA_real_ else cvm_stat(y[d$inl]))
  })
  write_parquet(rew_w2, rew_file)
}

cat("RewML fits:", nrow(rew_w2), " failed:", sum(rew_w2$rew_failed), "\n")
```

```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 5}
cvm_summary <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    group_by(scenario, percentage, method_label) %>%
    summarise(med_w2    = median(w2_inlier),
              q25       = quantile(w2_inlier, 0.25),
              q75       = quantile(w2_inlier, 0.75),
              pct_above = 100 * mean(w2_inlier > w2_ref),
              n_valid   = n(),
              .groups   = "drop")
}

cvm_col <- c("Non-robust MLE" = "#E69F00", "RewML Box-Cox/YJ" = "grey50", "SHASH-i" = "#332288")

cvm_agg <- bind_rows(
  results_kept %>%
    filter(version %in% names(ver_lab), n == n_cvm, percentage %in% perc_fig, !is.na(w2_inlier)) %>%
    mutate(method_label = unname(ver_lab[version])) %>%
    cvm_summary(),
  rew_w2 %>%
    filter(!is.na(w2_inlier)) %>%
    mutate(method_label = "RewML Box-Cox/YJ") %>%
    cvm_summary()
) %>%
  mutate(method_label = factor(method_label, levels = names(cvm_col)),
         scenario     = factor(as.character(scenario), levels = scen_keep))

# values behind the figure
cvm_agg %>%
  mutate(across(c(med_w2, q25, q75), ~ round(.x, 3)), pct_above = round(pct_above, 1)) %>%
  arrange(scenario, percentage, method_label) %>%
  print(n = 60, width = Inf)

# symmetric scenarios in blues and green, right-skewed in orange
scen_col <- c("Normal" = "#08306B", "Heavy-tailed" = "#009E73",
              "Light-tailed" = "#56B4E9", "Right-skewed" = "#D55E00")
scen_shp <- c("Normal" = 16, "Heavy-tailed" = 17, "Light-tailed" = 15, "Right-skewed" = 1)

p5 <- cvm_agg %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = percentage, colour = scenario, fill = scenario, shape = scenario, group = scenario)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = w2_ref, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = med_w2), linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(y = med_w2), size = 2, stroke = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(. ~ method_label) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = perc_fig, labels = paste0(perc_fig * 100, "%")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = scen_col, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = scen_col, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = scen_shp, name = NULL) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1), fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1), shape = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Outlier percentage", y = "CvM statistic on true inliers") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 8, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("CvM_n", n_cvm, "_xContamination_byMethod.png")),
       p5, width = 8, height = 3.2, dpi = 500)
p5
```
